attributes.name: intro_paragraph_typeface_style
attributes.definition: Typeface style used for the opening/lead paragraph of the page.

values.definition: Lead paragraph set in a serif typeface.
Lead paragraph set in a sans-serif typeface.
Other typeface or no distinct lead paragraph.

attributes.name: intro_paragraph_scale
attributes.definition: Size of the opening paragraph relative to body text.

values.definition: Noticeably larger than body copy, set as a pulled-out lead.

attributes.name: intro_paragraph_alignment_layout
attributes.definition: How the intro paragraph and the copy following it are aligned and arranged.

values.definition: Intro text centered in a single column.
Lead paragraph followed by remaining copy in multiple columns.

attributes.name: intro_paragraph_leading
attributes.definition: Line spacing of the intro paragraph.
